fields.description: Automatic series for the task number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: What the task is, in one line, as it appears in the volunteer's list. The detail belongs in the description.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description: Who the task is assigned to. One volunteer — work for several people is several tasks.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: Which part of the society this task belongs to. Defaults to the volunteer's own branch.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: Where the work has got to. Declined is a volunteer saying no before starting; reassigned is the same work handed to somebody else, with this record kept.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
assigned
accepted
submitted
completed
cancelled
declined
reassigned

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: How urgent this is. Ranks a volunteer's list and a coordinator's; nothing else reads it.

fields.label: Task Type
fields.description: What this society calls this kind of work. An open vocabulary; no rule branches on it.
The deployment this task is part of, where it is part of one. Optional.
fields.label: Deployment
Project
fields.description: The programme this work belongs to.

fields.label: Batch
fields.description: The batch this task was generated from, where it was. Editing that batch afterwards changes nothing here.

fields.label: Due
fields.description: When it is due, to the hour. The day beside it is derived from this.
The day it is due. Derived from the due datetime beside it and shown because every register in this app windows on days.
fields.label: Due On
Planned Start
fields.description: When the work is expected to begin.

fields.label: Answer By
fields.description: By when the volunteer has to accept or decline. A prompt for whoever is chasing, never an automatic refusal.

fields.label: Expected Hours
fields.description: How long the work is expected to take.

fields.label: Actual Hours
fields.description: How long it took. Recorded at completion; separate from the volunteer's own time log, which is their account of it.

fields.label: Percent Complete
fields.description: How far along the work is, as the volunteer reports it.
What is being asked for, in full.
fields.label: Description
Briefing Files
fields.description: Forms, maps, templates and references provided by whoever set the work. Deliberately not the same place as the volunteer's evidence.

fields.label: Checklist
fields.description: What has to be done. A required item that is not ticked stops the task being submitted.

fields.label: Depends On
fields.description: Work that has to finish before this starts. A loop is refused; starting a blocked task needs a written override.

fields.label: Override Reason
fields.description: Why this task was started while something it depends on was unfinished. Required to start a blocked one, so the decision is somebody's and is written down.

fields.label: Work Location
fields.description: Where the work happens. A task under a deployment takes the deployment's own point unless this says otherwise.

fields.label: Located On
fields.description: When these coordinates were resolved from the address. Blank where somebody placed the pin themselves.

fields.label: Remind Every (Days)
fields.description: How often to nudge whoever holds this, while it is open and overdue. Zero — the shipped state — sends nothing.

fields.label: Last Contacted
fields.description: When this task last produced a reminder or an escalation. What stops the sweep sending the same nudge every hour.

fields.label: Escalate To
fields.description: Who hears about it when a reminder has not worked. Empty means nobody, and nothing is escalated.

fields.label: Escalations
fields.description: Every time this task was raised with somebody above the person holding it.
Ticked while the volunteer is waiting on an answer. It does not move the task backwards.
fields.label: Awaiting An Answer

fields.description: When the task was assigned. Response time is measured from here.
fields.label: Assigned On

fields.description: When the volunteer accepted it. Blank while nobody has answered.
fields.label: Accepted On

fields.description: When the volunteer offered the work as done. Cleared if a coordinator sends it back.
fields.label: Submitted On

fields.description: When the task was finished with, whether approved or cancelled.
fields.label: Closed On

fields.description: What the volunteer said when they offered the work as done. Photographs are in the thread below.
fields.label: Completion Notes
Outcome
fields.description: What came of the work, in the coordinator's words. Written at sign-off.

fields.label: Final Evidence
fields.description: The finished work itself, where it is a document or a photograph.

fields.label: Last Return Reason
fields.description: Why the work was last sent back. Kept after it is resubmitted, so a coordinator can see what was asked for.

fields.label: Times Returned
fields.description: How many times this work has been sent back. A fact about the task, not about the person.

fields.label: Rating
fields.description: Optional. Nothing in this app reads it; it is for a coordinator's own record.

fields.label: Reason For Declining
fields.description: Why the volunteer could not take it on. Their own words, kept so nobody has to guess.

fields.label: Reassigned To
fields.description: The task that took this one over. This record is kept exactly as it was.
The conversation, in order: assignment, acceptance, questions, progress and the decision that closed it.
fields.label: Updates
